name: Another Clue to Sanders' Treasure
summary: In Westfall, a scrap of Captain Sanders' parchment points toward his next hidden marker.

sections.title: A Trail on the Coastal Bluffs
sections.body: Captain Sanders hid his stolen riches across Westfall, leaving riddles and buried markers instead of one map that could be seized. This scrap carries the trail onward from the previous hiding place. It says to turn north and seek a discarded jug beside a lonely windmill above the sea cliffs.

faq.q: What is written on this clue?
faq.answer: The parchment says to face north from the hidden barrel and walk straight to an empty jug beside a lone windmill on the sea bluffs.
Captain Sanders was a pirate who left caches of stolen goods along Westfall's shores and bluffs. He hid markers across the region instead of leaving an intact map.

faq.q: Where does this clue lead next?
faq.answer: The clue points north along Westfall's coastal cliffs to a lone windmill on the bluffs, where an empty jug marks the next step in Sanders' trail.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you know how to read cryptic directions and search forgotten seaside caches for hidden plunder.
